title: Lawrence Chaney wins UK Series 2
summary: In the Grand Finale (UK-S02-E10), Ellie Diamond was eliminated without a lip sync, leaving Bimini Bon-Boulash, Lawrence Chaney, and Tayce. The final three lip-synced to Elton John's "I'm Still Standing". Lawrence Chaney was crowned; Bimini and Tayce finished as runners-up. Early UK series offered no cash prize.

title: Joe Black: first out, then back
summary: Joe Black was the first contestant eliminated on UK Series 2 (UK-S02-E01), lip-syncing to Frankie Goes to Hollywood's "Relax" against Bimini Bon-Boulash. After a COVID-related production break, Joe won the returning-queen vote in The RuRuvision Song Contest (UK-S02-E05) before being eliminated again.

title: UK Hun? chart success
summary: In UK-S02-E05, the queens wrote and performed verses to "UK Hun?". Team United Kingdolls (A'Whora, Bimini Bon-Boulash, Lawrence Chaney, and Tayce) won. The United Kingdolls version reached number 27 on the Official UK Singles Chart.

title: Ginny Lemon quits mid lip-sync
summary: In Morning Glory (UK-S02-E04), Ginny Lemon and Sister Sister lip-synced to Kim Wilde's "You Keep Me Hangin' On". Ginny walked off stage at the start of the performance and quit the competition; Sister Sister was declared the lip-sync winner.

title: Veronica Green withdrawn for COVID-19
summary: When filming resumed after a lockdown break for The RuRuvision Song Contest (UK-S02-E05), Veronica Green was removed after testing positive for COVID-19 and given an open invitation to return for Series 3. Joe Black re-entered via a cast vote among previously eliminated queens.
